boundaries.name: recursive-balance-proof-verification
boundaries.obligation: builder.verify_proof of the previous balance proof under the verifier data read from its own public inputs (proofAccepted) is an opaque acceptance premise; plonky2 recursive soundness, cyclic verifier-key pinning and the well-formedness (63-bit block_r, non-zero channel) of the previous statement are not established here.

boundaries.name: deposit-tree-inclusion
boundaries.obligation: depositMerkleAccepted / depositMerkleVerify are opaque: prove the IncrementalMerkleProof gadget opens the Poseidon-hashed deposit leaf at deposit_index under the connected root, and that the NEW public state's deposit root is the canonical on-chain deposit tree root (L1 finality of the deposit is a caller obligation).

boundaries.name: account-state-openings
boundaries.obligation: accountStateAccepted / accountStateVerify are opaque: send-leaf and channel-leaf Merkle openings under the NEW public state's account root, and the meaning of send_leaf.prev/cur and channel_leaf.prev as the receiver's outgoing history.

boundaries.name: poseidon-and-keccak
boundaries.obligation: poseidonBytes32 (nullifier and recipient) and keccak (settled-tx chain) are opaque callbacks; only preimage-layout injectivity (deposit_words_injective, recipient_preimage_injective) is proved, never hash injectivity, nullifier freshness or chain uniqueness. The u64 to (high, low) u32 split and the tag-byte replacement are modeled but their gadget lowering is not.

boundaries.name: goldilocks-comparison-lowering
boundaries.obligation: EnforceGe / ConditionalGe / ConditionalGt model enforce_ge as (self - lower mod p) < 2^63 with select/is_zero read exactly; prove that plonky2 sub, select, is_equal and split_le(63) implement these on canonical wires. Integer block-window theorems additionally assume the operands lie below 2^63 (checked allocations) and lower operands at most 2^63 - 2^32 + 1; the new public state's block_number is an UNCHECKED allocation in this circuit.

boundaries.name: checked-allocation-range-premises
boundaries.obligation: newBlockRange, accountRanges, depositChannelRange and depositRanges are premises standing for the range checks of BlockNumberTarget/AccountStateTarget/DepositWitnessTarget/UpdatePrivateStateTarget::new(_, true); their gate lowering is not proved.

boundaries.name: imported-gadget-interfaces
boundaries.obligation: getRoot (UpdatePublicState), assetRoot and nullifierCall (UpdatePrivateState) and convertFields (native field conversion of verifier data) keep the obligations of the imported current modules; the credit theorem relies on the imported per-limb AddGates relation whose field lowering is open.

boundaries.name: native-witness-and-proof-generation
boundaries.obligation: PartialWitness writes, the duplicated statement write in prove, CircuitData::prove and serde/bincode serialization (to_bytes/from_bytes, untranslated) are opaque; native success is satisfiability evidence only, never a soundness premise for arbitrary witnesses.

boundaries.name: callee-files-not-mapped
boundaries.obligation: DepositWitness::verify, Deposit::to_u64_vec/nullifier, calculate_recipient_from_user_id and U63Target::enforce_ge are modeled from their source files but no line maps for deposit_witness.rs, deposit.rs, recipient.rs or u63.rs are provided by this module.
